data.title: Coronary artery disease killed actor Ray MacDonald
data.description: The well-known Thai actor and travel content creator Ray MacDonald, who died suddenly on Wednesday at age 49, was suffering from triple-vessel coronary artery disease, according to his wife and close friends.

data.title: Students injured by swarming bees
data.description: CHON BURI — Seventeen people, including 13 students, were injured after a swarm of giant honey bees attacked them near the Bang Lamung district office in Chon Buri on Thursday morning.

data.title: Din Daeng hit by two fires in one day
data.description: A residential area of Din Daeng district of Bangkok was struck by fire twice on Wednesday, with the second blaze completely destroying a house and injuring two people.

data.title: Verstappen signs new Red Bull contract until 2030
data.description: ZANDVOORT, Netherlands - Four-time Formula One world champion Max Verstappen has signed a new contract with Red Bull until the end of 2030, the team announced Thursday, ending speculation over his future in the sport.

data.title: Architects fight to save historic dorm in Chiang Mai
data.description: Thai architects have called on Chiang Mai University to reconsider the demolition of the Ang Kaew Dormitory, considered a prime example of a bold, progressive milestone in the country’s architectural history.

data.title: TIDLOR Reinforces Strong Capital Base with 16,500 Million Yen Debenture Issuance
data.description: Tidlor Holdings Public Company Limited or Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) continues to strengthen its financial position and diversify its funding sources. Most recently, the Group issued its first Yen-denominated debentures, with a total value of 16,500 million yen with a tenor of 3 years, to expand access to funding in international markets and increase flexibility in managing the Group’s capital structure.

data.title: Five arrested for unlicensed dental and medical services
data.description: Consumer Protection Police have arrested five people accused of illegally providing dental and medical services in Bangkok, Samut Prakan and Samut Sakhon, seizing more than 1,000 items of medical equipment and supplies worth over 330,000 baht.

data.title: Kashmir remarks by US envoy to India anger Pakistan
data.description: ISLAMABAD - Pakistan has summoned Washington’s top envoy in Islamabad and “strongly condemned” remarks by the US ambassador to New Delhi calling disputed Kashmir “an important part of India”.

data.title: Australian Rules faces far-reaching fallout from latest scandal
data.description: SYDNEY - An alcohol-fuelled scandal swirling around a top Australian Rules team has been splashed across newspaper front pages as much as the back and triggered broader debate, a sign of the sport’s importance in the country’s social fabric.

data.title: US India ambassador's Kashmir remarks rile Pakistan; envoy summoned
data.description: ISLAMABAD (PAKISTAN) - Pakistan has summoned Washington's top envoy in Islamabad and "strongly condemned" remarks by the US ambassador to New Delhi calling disputed Kashmir "an important part of India".

data.title: Australian prosecutors demand life in prison for mushroom killer
data.description: MELBOURNE - Australian prosecutors asked judges Thursday to stiffen mushroom murderer Erin Patterson's prison sentence -- saying she should never be set free.

data.title: New movies out this week: Aug 20-26
data.description: Six new releases that hit cinemas in Thailand this week.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri backs Suakim decision but says Nabil rematch warranted
data.description: ONE Championship chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong believes Thai veteran Suakim Pongsuphan PK did enough to beat Nabil Anane – but says their disputed split decision is worthy of a rematch.

data.title: Australia angry as Israel declines to probe aid workers’ deaths
data.description: SYDNEY - Australia’s relations with Israel have been “difficult” since the latter dropped an investigation into the killing of an aid worker and her colleagues in Gaza, Foreign Minister Penny Wong said on Thursday.

data.title: Russian strikes kill nine in Kyiv region
data.description: KYIV - Russian bombardments killed at least nine peopleand wounded dozens in Ukraine’s capital and its surrounding region overnight, authorities said on Thursday.

data.title: Two suspects in Chiang Rai gold shop robbery arrested in Laos
data.description: Two suspects wanted in connection with the armed robbery of a gold shop at a major shopping mall in Chiang Khong district of Chiang Rai province earlier this month have been arrested in Laos.

data.title: Clean-up begins as floods pass through Nan
data.description: NAN - Rehabilitation work is beginning in upper and central districts of this northern province as floodwaters from the overflowing Nan River move south, governor Chainarong Wongyai said on Thursday.

data.title: Arteta says Arsenal can become world’s best club
data.description: LONDON - Mikel Arteta has warned Arsenal’s rivals that he plans to build the Premier League champions into the “best club in the world”.

data.title: Growing old, staying rooted: Lives along Bangkok’s floating market
data.description: At Wat Nimmanoradee’s 100-year-old market, in Bangkok’s Phasi Charoen district, memories of life along the canals remain vivid among longtime residents, even as the landscape around them has continued to change.

data.title: Who’s who in Iran’s new hardline security leadership
data.description: Earlier this month Iranian supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei reshuffled Tehran’s top security team, putting his own personal stamp on the appointments and readying the Islamic republic for a long-term confrontation with the United States.

data.title: Harry and Meghan ‘moving back to UK’
data.description: LONDON - Six years after stepping down as working royals, Prince Harry and his wife Meghan are moving back to the United Kingdom within weeks, British media reported late Wednesday.

data.title: Ukraine’s soldiers stress human role amid drone revolution
data.description: As the first ray of sun hit on an unexpectedly frosty August morning, a few hundred just-graduated Ukrainian paratroopers were traipsing across a corn and rapeseed field, preparing for their first jump.

data.title: Trump’s devoted ‘human printer’ in media glare
data.description: WASHINGTON - She is a near-constant presence at US President Donald Trump’s side, but until recently his ultra-loyal aide Natalie Harp had managed to stay out of the spotlight.

data.title: UK summons Israeli envoy over West Bank settlements
data.description: LONDON - Britain said on Wednesday it had summoned Israel's charge d'affaires and demanded a halt to a major West Bank settlement project after Israeli authorities opened bidding for more than 1,200 homes in the area.

data.title: Samut Sakhon motorway section to open Aug 28
data.description: The Department of Highways will open a 16.4-kilometre section of the M82 elevated motorway from Ekachai to Ban Phaeo in Samut Sakhon or a trial period on Aug 28.

data.title: Exam fraud investigation reports due by Aug 31
data.description: <p>The Interior Ministry has ordered local authorities to wrap up investigations into suspected fraud in local government examinations by the end of the month, while the Anti-Money Laundering Office (Amlo) examines financial trails for possible asset seizures.</p>

data.title: Bangkok to develop sky gardens
data.description: <p>Bangkok will develop sky gardens linking two of of the city's historical landmarks, the Golden Mount and Mahakan Fort.</p>

data.title: Election Commission pressed on Senate poll case
data.description: <p>Pressure is mounting on the Election Commission (EC) after a civic network, a group of reserve senators and a former MP urged the poll regulator to send a 2024 Senate election fraud case allegedly involving 229 people to court without further delay.</p>

data.title: People’s Party questions naming of MP in nominee probe
data.description: <p>The opposition People's Party (PP) has questioned the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) over its investigation into Phuket MP Somchat Techathaworncharoen, saying the disclosure of his name before any formal charges had been filed could create the impression that he had already committed an offence.</p>

data.title: Kuehne+Nagel invests in new Container Freight Station in Cambodia
data.description: New 20,000 sqm facility will more than triple Kuehne+Nagel’s container freight station capacity in Cambodia Strategic location strengthens cross-border connectivity between Cambodia, Thailand and Vietnam Expanded facility supports customers in the consumer goods industry
